Container.Name: claude-docker-proxy
Container.Overview:
Filtering Docker socket proxy for claude-unraid-manager (wollomatic/socket-proxy, pinned by digest).
It holds the real Docker socket and passes on only an allowlist of Docker API requests: listing and inspecting containers and images, reading logs and stats, and starting, stopping and restarting containers. Everything else (exec, creating or removing containers, pulls, builds, volumes, networks, copying files out of containers) is refused with 403.
It has no network at all: it serves the filtered socket as a file in /var/run/claude-docker-proxy, which only claude-unraid-manager mounts. Install and start this container first.
The allowlists below are the security boundary. Change them only if you know which Docker API calls you are allowing.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: The real Docker socket. Only this container mounts it.

Config.Name: Proxy Socket Directory
Config.Description: Where the filtered socket is created (RAM, recreated on every start). claude-unraid-manager mounts the same host directory read-only.

Config.Name: Proxy socket path
Config.Description: Serve the filtered API on this unix socket instead of a TCP port.

Config.Name: Proxy socket mode
Config.Description: File mode of the filtered socket. 0600: only root (claude-unraid-manager runs as root) can connect.

Config.Name: Allowed GET requests
Config.Description: Regex, anchored automatically. Container list/inspect/logs/stats/top, image list/inspect, version, info, events. Not allowed: archive and export (they copy files out of containers).

Config.Name: Allowed HEAD requests
Config.Description: The Docker CLI pings with HEAD before every command.

Config.Name: Allowed POST requests
Config.Description: Start, stop and restart of existing containers. Nothing else: no create, exec, kill, update or prune.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: INFO logs every refused request. DEBUG also logs allowed ones.
